topic: FDIC insurance covers far more than $250k at one bank if the money sits in different ownership categories
title: The FDIC's $250,000 Limit Is a Myth
description:
Everyone thinks the FDIC insures up to $250,000 per bank. That's not the whole story. The real limit is much higher if you understand how the rules on ownership categories actually work.
